record_notes.DCP-LETT-1237: March 30, 1849. Explicitly writes from Malvern despite Down dateline; address is not physical location. Beagle/officer and family news attributed as knowledge/report. Sydney Mail source and de Beer later divergent transcripts must remain distinct; apparatus suggests de Beer normalized usual writing style, no authority to silently adopt revisions.
